input:
Labeled defect
- root cause: Argument.get_help_record returns self.help unchanged, so the second element of the tuple is None for an undocumented argument even though format_arguments now feeds every record straight into formatter.write_dl without a fallback.
- failure path: A command declares two arguments and sets help on only one; running it with --help makes write_dl measure and wrap a None description and the help command crashes with a TypeError instead of printing usage.

Reviewer finding
- description: Arguments without help return `(metavar, None)` instead of `(metavar, "")`. This crashes help rendering when a command has both documented and undocumented positional arguments.
- rationale: For a command with one argument whose help is set and another whose help is None, the positional-arguments section is rendered and passes both records to formatter.write_dl. The undocumented argument now supplies None as its description, which the formatter expects to be a string, causing a TypeError instead of displaying help. The removed fallback previously supplied an empty string.
critique: The finding states that get_help_record returns None for an undocumented argument instead of an empty string. It says that None reaches formatter.write_dl when documented and undocumented arguments are mixed, and that this causes a TypeError. That is the same faulty operation and failure path as the label.
